answer: Give every identity a crystal-clear earning ladder: the first reward is free, but each further claim from the same identity must solve a fresh compute puzzle whose difficulty doubles with every claim. One honest agent climbs slowly and pays almost nothing. A farm of a thousand clones faces a thousand doubling ladders, and by the tenth claim each clone burns more electricity than the reward is worth. Like a lotus opening one petal at a time, the ladder only rewards steady growth, and a jade seal of prior work proves the climb is real, not copied.
